scope.support: Selected standard assertion helper bodies only; full support files retained but their tests/remainder unreviewed and uncounted.
scope.other_paths: Unselected peer files/directories remain unreviewed. Prior restricted Rust resource not retried or routed around.

grouping_policy: One named Zig test including all assertions/helpers, one Go errorcheck lexical block, or one Go if scenario. Grouped explicitly; no assertion/helper or listing promoted to test/port.
upstream_outcome_policy: Pinned source expectations only. array.zig assertions conditional on backend skip guards; assign.go is errorcheck and must not compile with four matching error annotations alongside accepted assignments; if.go //run expects silent success. Nothing executed.
local_coverage_policy: Inspected source ranges/hashes only; no executed/passing status. Exact gap is relative to listed source fixtures, not exhaustive repository absence.
ownership_policy: Existing simple syntax, automatic ownership and shared reference semantics preserved. No memory syntax, pointer/view/sentinel/tuple/type features proposed.

literal.extent: Ordered effectful List literal values 1,2,3; literal function arguments 7/seven; Boolean/Character and nested Text empty context. Different exact values/shape from selected peer cases.

capture.extent: Captured earlier record projection survives later List replacement; old!,new!,new!. Replacement lifetime, not deep copying.

empty.extent: Contextual empty return/reassignment length0; nested typed literal reads2. No comptime empty pointer coercion.

reject.extent: Homogeneous literal and Nothing/separator diagnostics; does not implement tuple coercion or zero-bit storage.

nested.extent: Two nested literal rows with one scalar mutation/read. Does not check cross-row independence.

fresh.extent: Ten dynamically constructed independent rows; mutation yields -1,10,99. Does not cover capturing/copying a row.

record.extent: Explicit record and nested List construction; Ada,36,language projections. All fields supplied.

fields.extent: Existing missing/duplicate/unknown-field and wrong-type diagnostics. Source only; no bootstrap invocation here.

effects.extent: Effectful record field initializers in source order; x12,y11,state12. No discarded List initializer oracle.

bytes.extent: Bytes initialized/indexed and one copied slice read; no subsequent copy independence mutation.

bytes-alias.extent: Bytes held in record/List is shared; mutations observed through original record.

bounds.extent: Empty/nonempty List reads/writes at length and extreme indices expect existing bounds diagnostic. No sentinel slot.

nothing.extent: Nothing rejected as field, parameter and List element; source diagnostics only.

alias.extent: List alias/self assignment plus immutable old Text survival after replacement. Does not assert deep List copying.

param.extent: Shared List parameter update/append exposes length2 and values6,6. Scalars are not addressable arguments.

branch.extent: Ordinary Boolean branches return42/7; terminal fail branch and bare return. Different exact count oracles.

scope.extent: Branch-local shadow prints20, then outer11. Related lexical binding coverage.

sibling.extent: Reject branch-local names in sibling branches and non-Boolean conditions. No Go initializer clause syntax.

proposed_regressions.name: Literal arguments, contextual indexing and ordered values
proposed_regressions.original_regression: Use literal and runtime two=2 in List argument helpers, with and without Boolean true; check every1,2,3. Check scalar lists[42,56,54], one-element2, owner[10,20], helper123 and[123,456,123,456]. Select index via ordinary if from true/false and read170/85.

proposed_regressions.name: Ragged nested values and explicit sharing controls

Build two separately initialized rows of ten11s and a separate deliberately shared-row control; mutate one and distinguish independent from shared rows. proposed_regressions.name: Empty runtime containers and no sentinel

proposed_regressions.name: Unused initializer effects and ordered trace

Separately four helpers add1,2,4,8 and return each value; check exact list and state15. Add decimal trace for order1,2,3,4, so order is independently observed.

proposed_regressions.name: Shared row binding versus explicit snapshot
proposed_regressions.original_regression: Start initialized nested rows with chosen slot0; bind alias=x[0]; create fresh copied row by explicit scalar iteration into a new Integer List before mutation; set source chosen slot15. Check alias15, explicit snapshot0. Replace the source outer position, drop local source references, and check retained alias15/snapshot0.
proposed_regressions.expected: Plain alias15; fresh snapshot0; both retained values remain15/0 after source replacement.
proposed_regressions.existing_gap: Zig asserts0 from an implicit value copy; this Minyar contrast follows current shared ownership. Existing dynamic independent rows/managed projection capture are related, but do not assert this exact alias-versus-explicit-snapshot contrast.

proposed_regressions.name: Scalar filling and record construction versus sharing
proposed_regressions.original_regression: Fill ten Integer values123. Construct ten fresh Cell{x:10} records and check fields individually; separately add the same Cell ten times, mutate its x and observe all entries. Mutation of one fresh cell must preserve other fresh cells.
proposed_regressions.expected: Ten123 values; ten initial fields10; one fresh mutation affects only its cell; one deliberately shared record mutation affects every shared position.

proposed_regressions.name: Exact branch counts and scoped explicit initializer
